title: Nominal run: a draft for each of the five mails that call for one, none quoting a mail, none taken from another mail

checks.pattern: The orange kite drifts above the harbour wall\.
A silver spoon rests beside the empty teacup\.
Le chat gris dort sur la troisième marche\.
Seven lanterns glow along the wooden pier\.
Une plume bleue repose sur le rebord de la fenêtre\.
The red bicycle leans against the old oak\.
Trois galets blancs brillent au fond du ruisseau\.
Le vieux phare clignote deux fois par minute\.
A paper boat sails across the puddle\.
The green parrot counts backwards from ten\.
A violet umbrella opens in the empty hall\.
A copper kettle whistles in the distant kitchen\.
